The equilibrium quote weights in equations (23) and (24) are scrambled, with coefficients separated from their terms. The mix of own value and the two bounds follows the prose.
The three policy formulas and the culture formula are flattened, and the national price is said to be computed by machine. Only the externality correction is transcribed.
Equation (30) detaches the index ranges from the sum. The reading as loss times probability over fields and groups follows the prose.
